1.name: Beetroot
1.selectionGuide: Firm, smooth skin, intact taproot. For greens attached, leaves should be fresh not wilted.
1.storageGuide: Remove greens leaving 1 inch of stem. Store unwashed in a perforated plastic bag in the fridge crisper.
1.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 43 kcal; carbohydrates 9.6 g; fiber 2.8 g; protein 1.6 g.

default-1.name: Classic Beetroot recipe
default-1.instructions: Roast beet wedges with olive oil, thyme, and a little vinegar until tender.

2.name: Asparagus
2.selectionGuide: Firm, straight stalks with closed, tight tips. Ends should be moist, not dry.
2.storageGuide: Trim the ends and stand stalks upright in a glass with an inch of water. Loosely cover the tips with a plastic bag in the fridge.
2.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 20 kcal; carbohydrates 3.9 g; fiber 2.1 g; protein 2.2 g.

default-2.name: Classic Asparagus recipe
default-2.instructions: Roast asparagus spears with olive oil; finish with lemon zest.

3.name: Pumpkin
3.selectionGuide: Hard rind (cannot be punctured with a fingernail), hollow sound when tapped. Stem should be dry.
3.storageGuide: Store whole pumpkins in a cool, dark, dry, and well-ventilated place. Once cut, wrap tightly in plastic and refrigerate.
3.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 26 kcal; carbohydrates 6.5 g; fiber 0.5 g; protein 1 g.

default-3.name: Classic Pumpkin recipe
default-3.instructions: Roast pumpkin cubes with oil and spices, then blend with stock into soup.

4.name: Carrot
4.selectionGuide: Firm, bright orange, smooth skin. Avoid cracks or rubbery texture.
4.storageGuide: Remove greens. Submerge completely in water in a sealed container in the fridge. Change water every few days.
4.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 41 kcal; carbohydrates 9.6 g; fiber 2.8 g; protein 0.9 g.

default-4.name: Classic Carrot recipe
default-4.instructions: Simmer sliced carrots with vegetable stock, then blend with ginger for soup.

5.name: Potato
5.selectionGuide: Firm, smooth skin, no green tints or sprouts. New potatoes should have flaky skin.
5.storageGuide: Keep in a cool, dark, dry, well-ventilated place (like a paper bag in a pantry). Do not refrigerate. Keep away from onions.
5.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 77 kcal; carbohydrates 17.5 g; fiber 2.2 g; protein 2 g.

default-5.name: Classic Potato recipe
default-5.instructions: Boil potatoes until tender and toss with dill, spring onion, and yogurt.

6.name: Tomato
6.selectionGuide: Fragrant, rich color, slightly yielding to pressure. Heavy for size.
6.storageGuide: Keep stem-side down at room temperature, out of direct sunlight for best flavor. Refrigeration can slow deterioration of ripe tomatoes, but may affect flavor and texture.
6.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 18 kcal; carbohydrates 3.9 g; fiber 1.2 g; protein 0.9 g.

default-6.name: Classic Tomato recipe
default-6.instructions: Bake tomato halves with olive oil, garlic, and herbs until soft.

7.name: Cucumber
7.selectionGuide: Firm along entire length. Avoid shriveled ends or soft spots.
7.storageGuide: Wrap individually in paper towels, place in a plastic bag, and store towards the front of the fridge shelf where it's warmer.
7.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 15 kcal; carbohydrates 3.6 g; fiber 0.5 g; protein 0.7 g.

default-7.name: Classic Cucumber recipe
default-7.instructions: Dice cucumber and mix with yogurt, dill, and a little lemon juice.

8.name: Radish
8.selectionGuide: Firm, smooth, bright color. If leaves are attached, they should be green and crisp.
8.storageGuide: Remove greens immediately. Store roots submerged in a jar of water in the fridge to keep them crisp.
8.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 16 kcal; carbohydrates 3.4 g; fiber 1.6 g; protein 0.7 g.

default-8.name: Classic Radish recipe
default-8.instructions: Thinly slice radishes and toss with butter, lemon, and chopped herbs.

9.name: Cauliflower
9.selectionGuide: Compact, creamy white curds. No dark spots. Leaves should be fresh green.
9.storageGuide: Store stem-side down in a loosely sealed plastic bag with a dry paper towel to absorb moisture in the fridge.
9.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 25 kcal; carbohydrates 5 g; fiber 2 g; protein 1.9 g.

default-9.name: Classic Cauliflower recipe
default-9.instructions: Steam cauliflower florets and serve with a sauce of yogurt, garlic, and herbs.

10.name: Broccoli
10.selectionGuide: Firm stalks, tight dark green florets. Avoid yellowing buds.
10.storageGuide: Mist the head lightly, wrap loosely in damp paper towels, and keep in an unsealed bag in the fridge.
10.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 34 kcal; carbohydrates 6.6 g; fiber 2.6 g; protein 2.8 g.

default-10.name: Classic Broccoli recipe
default-10.instructions: Steam broccoli until just tender and toss with lemon and toasted almonds.

11.name: Zucchini
11.selectionGuide: Small to medium size, shiny skin. Avoid soft spots.
11.storageGuide: Keep dry and unwashed. Store in a paper bag or loose plastic bag with a paper towel in the crisper drawer.
11.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 17 kcal; carbohydrates 3.1 g; fiber 1 g; protein 1.2 g.

default-11.name: Classic Zucchini recipe
default-11.instructions: Grate zucchini into fritters with egg, flour, and herbs; pan-fry until golden.

12.name: Pepper
12.selectionGuide: Glossy, taut skin, firm stem. Heavy for size.
12.storageGuide: Store unwashed in a loosely tied plastic bag in the crisper drawer. Keep them completely dry.
12.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 31 kcal; carbohydrates 6 g; fiber 2.1 g; protein 1 g.

default-12.name: Classic Pepper recipe
default-12.instructions: Fill pepper halves with cooked rice, herbs, and beans, then bake until tender.

13.name: Beans (Broad)
13.selectionGuide: Pods should be green and filled, but not bulging excessively (indicates old/hard beans).
13.storageGuide: Store unshelled in a paper bag or perforated plastic bag in the crisper drawer for up to a few days.
13.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 88 kcal; carbohydrates 17.6 g; fiber 7.5 g; protein 7.9 g.

default-13.name: Classic Beans (Broad) recipe
default-13.instructions: Boil shelled broad beans until tender and toss with mint and lemon.

14.name: Beans (Green)
14.selectionGuide: Bright color, snaps easily when bent. Avoid tough or stringy pods.
14.storageGuide: Keep unwashed. Wrap in a dry paper towel and place inside a reusable plastic bag in the fridge crisper.
14.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 31 kcal; carbohydrates 7 g; fiber 2.7 g; protein 1.8 g.

default-14.name: Classic Beans (Green) recipe
default-14.instructions: Steam green beans until crisp-tender and toss with garlic and olive oil.

15.name: Cabbage (White)
15.selectionGuide: Heavy for size, tight leaves. Young cabbage is looser and greener.
15.storageGuide: Do not wash. Keep the whole head wrapped tightly in plastic wrap in the crisper drawer.
15.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 25 kcal; carbohydrates 5.8 g; fiber 2.5 g; protein 1.3 g.

default-15.name: Classic Cabbage (White) recipe
default-15.instructions: Finely shred cabbage and dress with grated carrot, yogurt, and vinegar.

16.name: Brussels Sprouts
16.selectionGuide: Tight, small, bright green heads. Avoid yellow leaves or loose structure.
16.storageGuide: Leave on the stalk if possible. Otherwise, store unwashed in a loose plastic bag in the fridge crisper.
16.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 43 kcal; carbohydrates 9 g; fiber 3.8 g; protein 3.4 g.

default-16.name: Classic Brussels Sprouts recipe
default-16.instructions: Roast halved Brussels sprouts with oil until browned; finish with lemon.

17.name: Kale
17.selectionGuide: Dark green, crisp leaves. Avoid yellow or mushy spots.
17.storageGuide: Wrap unwashed leaves in dry paper towels and store in a sealed plastic bag in the fridge.
17.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 49 kcal; carbohydrates 8.8 g; fiber 3.6 g; protein 4.3 g.

default-17.name: Classic Kale recipe
default-17.instructions: Massage chopped kale with olive oil and lemon, then top with seeds.

18.name: Spinach
18.selectionGuide: Vibrant green, fresh looking. Avoid slimy or wilted leaves.
18.storageGuide: Store unwashed in a hard, airtight container lined with dry paper towels to absorb excess moisture.
18.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 23 kcal; carbohydrates 3.6 g; fiber 2.2 g; protein 2.9 g.

default-18.name: Classic Spinach recipe
default-18.instructions: Wilt spinach in a pan with garlic and serve as a warm side dish.

19.name: Rhubarb
19.selectionGuide: Firm, crisp stalks. Avoid limp or rubbery ones.
19.storageGuide: Wrap unwashed stalks tightly in aluminum foil and store in the crisper drawer of the fridge.
19.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 21 kcal; carbohydrates 4.5 g; fiber 1.8 g; protein 0.9 g.

default-19.name: Classic Rhubarb recipe
default-19.instructions: Stew chopped rhubarb with a little sugar and orange zest; serve over yogurt.

20.name: Onion
20.selectionGuide: Hard, dry, papery skin. Avoid sprouting necks or soft spots.
20.storageGuide: Store in a cool, dark, dry, and well-ventilated spot (like a wire basket). Do not refrigerate or put in plastic. Keep away from potatoes.
20.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 40 kcal; carbohydrates 9.3 g; fiber 1.7 g; protein 1.1 g.

default-20.name: Classic Onion recipe
default-20.instructions: Cook sliced onions slowly until golden and serve on toast with thyme.

21.name: Strawberries
21.selectionGuide: Bright red all over, fresh green cap, strong sweet smell. Avoid white shoulders.
21.storageGuide: Store unwashed in a single layer inside an airtight container lined with a dry paper towel in the fridge.
21.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 32 kcal; carbohydrates 7.7 g; fiber 2 g; protein 0.7 g.

default-21.name: Classic Strawberries recipe
default-21.instructions: Slice strawberries and mix with oats, yogurt, and a little lemon zest.

22.name: Apples
22.selectionGuide: Firm, unbruised, skin should be tight not wrinkled.
22.storageGuide: Store in the crisper drawer, ideally in a perforated plastic bag. Keep separate from other sensitive vegetables.
22.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 52 kcal; carbohydrates 13.8 g; fiber 2.4 g; protein 0.3 g.

default-22.name: Classic Apples recipe
default-22.instructions: Bake sliced apples with cinnamon and oats until soft for a simple crumble.

23.name: Pears
23.selectionGuide: Check the neck: if it yields to gentle pressure, it is ripe. Body can be firm.
23.storageGuide: Ripen at room temperature. Once the neck yields to pressure, move to the fridge to halt ripening.
23.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 57 kcal; carbohydrates 15.2 g; fiber 3.1 g; protein 0.4 g.

default-23.name: Classic Pears recipe
default-23.instructions: Poach pear halves gently with cinnamon and serve with plain yogurt.

24.name: Plums
24.selectionGuide: Slightly soft at the tip, rich color, dusty bloom on skin is good.
24.storageGuide: Leave at room temperature in a paper bag to ripen. Once soft, transfer unwashed to the fridge.
24.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 46 kcal; carbohydrates 11.4 g; fiber 1.4 g; protein 0.7 g.

default-24.name: Classic Plums recipe
default-24.instructions: Simmer chopped plums with cinnamon into a quick compote.

25.name: Cherries (Sweet)
25.selectionGuide: Green, flexible stems. Fruit should be shiny, plump and dark.
25.storageGuide: Store unwashed with stems attached. Keep loosely packed in a paper-towel-lined container in the fridge.
25.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 63 kcal; carbohydrates 16 g; fiber 2.1 g; protein 1.1 g.

default-25.name: Classic Cherries (Sweet) recipe
default-25.instructions: Pit sweet cherries and fold into oatmeal with a spoonful of yogurt.

27.name: Raspberries
27.selectionGuide: Dry, plump, bright color. Check container bottom for juice (sign of crushing).
27.storageGuide: Do not wash until eating. Store in a wide, shallow container lined with paper towels, slightly open for airflow in the fridge.
27.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 52 kcal; carbohydrates 11.9 g; fiber 6.5 g; protein 1.2 g.

default-27.name: Classic Raspberries recipe
default-27.instructions: Mash raspberries with lemon juice and spoon over pancakes or yogurt.

28.name: Blueberries
28.selectionGuide: Firm, dusty blue color (bloom). Avoid soft or shriveled berries.
28.storageGuide: Pick out any moldy ones first. Store unwashed in a breathable or vented container in the fridge.
28.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 57 kcal; carbohydrates 14.5 g; fiber 2.4 g; protein 0.7 g.

default-28.name: Classic Blueberries recipe
default-28.instructions: Warm blueberries briefly with lemon to make a topping for porridge.

32.name: Grapes
32.selectionGuide: Plump, firmly attached to green stems. Avoid wrinkled berries.
32.storageGuide: Keep unwashed in their original ventilated bag or a perforated plastic bag in the fridge crisper.
32.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 69 kcal; carbohydrates 18.1 g; fiber 0.9 g; protein 0.7 g.

default-32.name: Classic Grapes recipe
default-32.instructions: Roast halved grapes with thyme and serve with soft cheese and bread.

34.name: Celery Root
34.selectionGuide: Heavy for its size, firm, no soft spots. Smaller roots tend to be less woody.
34.storageGuide: Store unwashed and loosely wrapped in a plastic bag in the fridge crisper drawer.
34.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 42 kcal; carbohydrates 9.2 g; fiber 1.8 g; protein 1.5 g.

default-34.name: Classic Celery Root recipe
default-34.instructions: Roast celeriac cubes with oil and rosemary; serve with a lemon dressing.

35.name: Parsley Root
35.selectionGuide: Firm, white/beige skin. Avoid rusty spots or limp roots.
35.storageGuide: Remove greens. Wrap the root in a lightly damp paper towel and store in an airtight container or bag in the fridge.
35.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 55 kcal; carbohydrates 12.3 g; fiber 4.3 g; protein 2.3 g.

default-35.name: Classic Parsley Root recipe
default-35.instructions: Grate parsley root into a slaw with apple, lemon juice, and yogurt.

36.name: Leek
36.selectionGuide: Crisp white and light green parts. Avoid yellowing or slimy leaves.
36.storageGuide: Store unwashed and untrimmed, loosely wrapped in a plastic bag in the crisper drawer of the fridge.
36.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 61 kcal; carbohydrates 14.2 g; fiber 1.8 g; protein 1.5 g.

default-36.name: Classic Leek recipe
default-36.instructions: Simmer sliced leek and potato in stock, then blend into a smooth soup.

37.name: Kohlrabi
37.selectionGuide: Small to medium size (tennis ball). Heavy and firm. Large ones can be woody inside.
37.storageGuide: Remove leaves. Store the unwashed bulb loose or in a perforated bag in the crisper drawer.
37.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 27 kcal; carbohydrates 6.2 g; fiber 3.6 g; protein 1.7 g.

default-37.name: Classic Kohlrabi recipe
default-37.instructions: Cut kohlrabi into sticks and serve raw with a yogurt and dill dip.

39.name: Eggplant
39.selectionGuide: Shiny, smooth skin. Firm but bounces back slightly when pressed. Heavy.
39.storageGuide: Store at cool room temperature away from bananas/tomatoes. If refrigerating, wrap in paper towel in the crisper and use quickly.
39.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 25 kcal; carbohydrates 5.9 g; fiber 3 g; protein 1 g.

default-39.name: Classic Eggplant recipe
default-39.instructions: Roast eggplant slices with olive oil and garlic; serve with tomato sauce.

41.name: Wild Bilberries
41.selectionGuide: Dark, almost black, distinct aroma. Will stain hands. Must be dry.
41.storageGuide: Pick out crushed berries. Store unwashed in a shallow container in the fridge. Wash just before eating.
41.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 57 kcal; carbohydrates 14.5 g; fiber 2.4 g; protein 0.7 g.
41.nutritionNote: Reference values are for cultivated blueberries; bilberries may differ.

default-41.name: Classic Wild Bilberries recipe
default-41.instructions: Simmer bilberries with a splash of water and serve as a warm porridge topping.

45.name: Parsnip
45.selectionGuide: Firm, ivory color. Avoid very large roots as they can be woody cores.
45.storageGuide: Store unwashed in a perforated plastic bag in the vegetable drawer of the fridge.
45.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 75 kcal; carbohydrates 18 g; fiber 4.9 g; protein 1.2 g.

default-45.name: Classic Parsnip recipe
default-45.instructions: Roast parsnip batons with oil and cumin until golden.

49.name: Jerusalem Artichoke
49.selectionGuide: Firm, not shriveled. Knobby is normal, but avoid soft spots/mold.
49.storageGuide: Wrap unwashed tubers in a paper towel inside a loose plastic bag in the fridge crisper.
49.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 73 kcal; carbohydrates 17.4 g; fiber 1.6 g; protein 2 g.

default-49.name: Classic Jerusalem Artichoke recipe
default-49.instructions: Roast scrubbed Jerusalem artichokes with garlic and olive oil until soft.

51.name: Horseradish
51.selectionGuide: Very hard and firm. Avoid shriveled roots or soft ends.
51.storageGuide: Wrap the unwashed root loosely in plastic wrap or keep in a perforated bag in the crisper drawer.
51.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 48 kcal; carbohydrates 11.3 g; fiber 3.3 g; protein 1.2 g.

default-51.name: Classic Horseradish recipe
default-51.instructions: Mix freshly grated horseradish with yogurt, lemon, and a pinch of salt for a sauce.

52.name: Spring Onion
52.selectionGuide: Bright green, crisp stalks. Avoid slimy or wilting tips.
52.storageGuide: Stand them upright in a jar with an inch of water at the bottom, loosely covered with a plastic bag in the fridge.
52.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 32 kcal; carbohydrates 7.3 g; fiber 2.6 g; protein 1.8 g.

default-52.name: Classic Spring Onion recipe
default-52.instructions: Stir-fry chopped spring onions briefly and fold into scrambled eggs.

63.name: Wild Strawberries
63.selectionGuide: Intense aroma is key. Very delicate, buy only if dry and not squashed.
63.storageGuide: Highly perishable. Eat immediately or store unwashed in a single layer in the fridge for no more than a day.
63.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 32 kcal; carbohydrates 7.7 g; fiber 2 g; protein 0.7 g.
63.nutritionNote: Reference values are for cultivated strawberries; wild strawberries may differ.

default-63.name: Classic Wild Strawberries recipe
default-63.instructions: Serve wild strawberries over plain yogurt with crushed oats.

70.name: Corn
70.selectionGuide: Bright green husk, golden silk (not dried black). Kernels should look plump and release milky juice when punctured.
70.storageGuide: Keep unhusked in a loosely closed plastic bag in the fridge. Consume as soon as possible, as sugars quickly turn to starch.
70.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 86 kcal; carbohydrates 19 g; fiber 2.7 g; protein 3.3 g.

default-70.name: Classic Corn recipe
default-70.instructions: Boil or grill corn on the cob and serve with butter and chopped herbs.

71.name: Watermelon
71.selectionGuide: Heavy for size, hollow sound when tapped. Look for a creamy yellow spot (field spot) where it sat on ground.
71.storageGuide: Keep whole watermelons at room temperature. Once cut, wrap the exposed flesh tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate.
71.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 30 kcal; carbohydrates 7.6 g; fiber 0.4 g; protein 0.6 g.

default-71.name: Classic Watermelon recipe
default-71.instructions: Dice watermelon and toss with mint and lime for a chilled fruit salad.

72.name: Melon (Cantaloupe/Honeydew)
72.selectionGuide: Sweet fragrance at the stem end. Slightly soft at the blossom end (opposite stem).
72.storageGuide: Ripen at room temperature. Once ripe, store whole in the fridge. Cut melon must be refrigerated in an airtight container.
72.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 34 kcal; carbohydrates 8.2 g; fiber 0.9 g; protein 0.8 g.
72.nutritionNote: Reference values are for cantaloupe; honeydew melon differs.

default-72.name: Classic Melon (Cantaloupe/Honeydew) recipe
default-72.instructions: Scoop melon into balls and serve chilled with mint and lime juice.

73.name: Orange
73.selectionGuide: Heavy for its size (means juicy). Firm, finely textured skin.
73.storageGuide: Store loose in the crisper drawer of the fridge for maximum freshness (up to a month). Room temp is fine for a few days.
73.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 47 kcal; carbohydrates 11.8 g; fiber 2.4 g; protein 0.9 g.

default-73.name: Classic Orange recipe
default-73.instructions: Add orange segments to a salad with fennel and a light olive-oil dressing.

74.name: Tangerine/Clementine
74.selectionGuide: Bright orange, skin feels slightly loose (easy to peel) but fruit should be heavy.
74.storageGuide: Keep them loose in the crisper drawer of the fridge to prevent them from drying out quickly.
74.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 53 kcal; carbohydrates 13.3 g; fiber 1.8 g; protein 0.8 g.
74.nutritionNote: Reference values are for tangerines; clementines may differ.

default-74.name: Classic Tangerine/Clementine recipe
default-74.instructions: Toss peeled mandarin segments with spinach and toasted nuts.

75.name: Lemon
75.selectionGuide: Bright yellow, heavy. Thin-skinned lemons are juicier.
75.storageGuide: Store submerged in water in an airtight container in the fridge to keep them firm and juicy for weeks.
75.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 29 kcal; carbohydrates 9.3 g; fiber 2.8 g; protein 1.1 g.

default-75.name: Classic Lemon recipe
default-75.instructions: Mix lemon juice and zest with olive oil and herbs for a bright dressing.

76.name: Grapefruit
76.selectionGuide: Heavy for size, firm but slightly springy. Flat ends usually indicate good ripeness.
76.storageGuide: Store loose in the fridge crisper drawer to maximize shelf life.
76.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 42 kcal; carbohydrates 10.7 g; fiber 1.6 g; protein 0.8 g.

default-76.name: Classic Grapefruit recipe
default-76.instructions: Broil grapefruit halves briefly and serve warm with a little honey.

77.name: Pomegranate
77.selectionGuide: Heavy, angular shape (not perfectly round means seeds are full), dark red skin.
77.storageGuide: Keep whole fruits in the fridge crisper drawer. Extracted seeds should go in an airtight container.
77.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 83 kcal; carbohydrates 18.7 g; fiber 4 g; protein 1.7 g.

default-77.name: Classic Pomegranate recipe
default-77.instructions: Scatter pomegranate seeds over roasted vegetables and a yogurt dressing.

78.name: Persimmon (Kaki)
78.selectionGuide: Astringent types (such as Hachiya) must soften fully before eating; non-astringent types (such as Fuyu) can be eaten while firm.
78.storageGuide: Ripen at room temperature. Astringent varieties must soften fully before eating; refrigerate ripe fruit.
78.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 70 kcal; carbohydrates 18.6 g; fiber 3.6 g; protein 0.6 g.

default-78.name: Classic Persimmon (Kaki) recipe
default-78.instructions: Slice ripe persimmon and serve with yogurt, toasted nuts, and cinnamon.

79.name: Fig
79.selectionGuide: Soft to touch, neck should droop. Small splits in skin indicate peak ripeness.
79.storageGuide: Place unwashed in a single layer on a paper towel-lined plate, covered loosely with plastic wrap in the fridge.
79.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 74 kcal; carbohydrates 19.2 g; fiber 2.9 g; protein 0.8 g.

default-79.name: Classic Fig recipe
default-79.instructions: Bake halved figs with a little honey and serve with soft cheese.

80.name: Nectarine/Peach
80.selectionGuide: Ignore the red blush; the background color should be non-green (yellow or cream/white, depending on variety). The fruit should yield slightly along the seam.
80.storageGuide: Ripen stem-side down at room temperature. Once ripe and fragrant, store in the fridge crisper.
80.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 39 kcal; carbohydrates 9.5 g; fiber 1.5 g; protein 0.9 g.
80.nutritionNote: Reference values are for peaches; nectarines may differ.

default-80.name: Classic Nectarine/Peach recipe
default-80.instructions: Grill peach or nectarine halves and serve with plain yogurt.

81.name: Kiwi
81.selectionGuide: Yields to gentle thumb pressure. Avoid rock hard (unripe) or mushy (overripe).
81.storageGuide: Leave firm kiwis at room temp to ripen. Once soft, transfer to a plastic bag in the fridge.
81.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 61 kcal; carbohydrates 14.7 g; fiber 3 g; protein 1.1 g.

default-81.name: Classic Kiwi recipe
default-81.instructions: Slice kiwi over porridge or yogurt and add a handful of oats.

82.name: Avocado
82.selectionGuide: Hass: Dark skin, yields gently to pressure. Green skins: Firm but not rock hard, skin stays green.
82.storageGuide: Ripen at room temperature. Once it yields gently, store whole in the fridge to pause ripening. For cut halves, squeeze lemon juice and wrap tightly in plastic.
82.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 160 kcal; carbohydrates 8.5 g; fiber 6.7 g; protein 2 g.

default-82.name: Classic Avocado recipe
default-82.instructions: Mash avocado with lime, chopped tomato, and a pinch of salt for a quick spread.

83.name: Mango
83.selectionGuide: Slightly soft to touch, fruity aroma at stem. Color is not a reliable indicator of ripeness.
83.storageGuide: Ripen at room temperature. Once ripe, move to the fridge to extend its shelf life by a few days.
83.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 60 kcal; carbohydrates 15 g; fiber 1.6 g; protein 0.8 g.

default-83.name: Classic Mango recipe
default-83.instructions: Blend mango with plain yogurt and lime for a simple chilled smoothie.

20b.name: Garlic
20b.selectionGuide: Firm, tight skin, heavy for size. Avoid if cloves feel hollow or soft.
20b.storageGuide: Keep in a dry, dark, well-ventilated space at room temperature. A mesh bag or open basket is ideal.
20b.nutritionalInfo: Per 100 g raw: 149 kcal; carbohydrates 33.1 g; fiber 2.1 g; protein 6.4 g.

default-20b.name: Classic Garlic recipe
default-20b.instructions: Roast a whole garlic bulb until soft; squeeze the cloves into mashed potatoes.
